metadata.name: bucket
metadata.description: Namespaced message buckets: encrypted document references with on-chain roles

docs: Namespaced message buckets for the realXmarket protocol.
A namespace belongs to an entity such as a property. Its managers create
buckets under it and seat each bucket's admins. Admins seat contributors
and viewers, hold the bucket's encryption key, and can pause writing.
Contributors write messages: references to encrypted documents held off
chain, with descriptive metadata on chain. Viewers are X25519 public keys
the documents are encrypted for; they never transact.
Every record is a rent-exempt account paid by whoever creates it and
refunded when it is removed.

instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Complete the authority handover. Signed by the pending authority.

instructions.name: add_admin
docs: Seat a bucket admin. Manager-only.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Proves the signer manages the bucket's namespace.

instructions.name: add_contributor
docs: Seat a contributor. Admin-only.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Proves the signer is one of the bucket's admins.

instructions.name: add_manager
docs: Seat another manager on a namespace. Manager-only.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Proves the signer manages this namespace.

instructions.name: add_viewer
docs: List a viewer's X25519 public key. Admin-only.

instructions.name: create_bucket
docs: Create a bucket under a namespace. Manager-only. A new bucket is
locked until an admin sets its key.

accounts.name: manager
docs: Proves the signer manages this namespace.

instructions.name: create_namespace
docs: Create a namespace; the signer becomes its first manager.

instructions.name: create_tag
docs: Create a tag messages in the bucket may carry. Admin-only.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Proves the signer is one of the bucket's admins.

instructions.name: force_add_manager
docs: Seat a manager without being one. Authority-only.

instructions.name: force_remove_bucket
docs: Remove an emptied bucket. Authority-only.

instructions.name: force_remove_manager
docs: Unseat any manager, the last one included. Authority-only.

instructions.name: force_remove_message
docs: Remove a message and refund its contributor. Authority-only.

instructions.name: force_remove_namespace
docs: Remove an emptied namespace. Authority-only.

instructions.name: force_remove_tag
docs: Remove a tag no message carries. Authority-only.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Initialize the singleton config; the signer becomes the authority.

accounts.name: program
docs: This program's executable account, tying `program_data` to it.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's upgrade authority must be the initializing signer.

instructions.name: pause_writing
docs: Lock the bucket; nothing can be written until a key is set. Admin-only.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Proves the signer is one of the bucket's admins.

instructions.name: remove_admin
docs: Unseat a bucket admin. Manager-only.

instructions.name: remove_contributor
docs: Unseat a contributor. Admin-only.

instructions.name: remove_manager
docs: Unseat a manager. Manager-only; the last manager cannot be removed.

instructions.name: remove_viewer
docs: Delist a viewer. Admin-only.

instructions.name: resume_writing
docs: Set the bucket's key and open it for writing. Admin-only.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Proves the signer is one of the bucket's admins.

instructions.name: rotate_key
docs: Replace the key of an open bucket. Admin-only; fails while locked.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Proves the signer is one of the bucket's admins.

instructions.name: update_authority
docs: Propose a new authority (two-step handover). Authority-only.

instructions.name: write
docs: Write a message. Contributor-only; the bucket must be open and the
tag, if the message names one, must exist.

accounts.name: contributor
docs: Proves the signer is one of the bucket's contributors.

accounts.name: tag
docs: Matched against the input's tag in the handler.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the program upgrade authority

errors.name: NotPendingAuthority
errors.msg: Signer is not the pending authority

errors.name: MetadataTooLong
errors.msg: A metadata field exceeds its length limit

errors.name: WrongTag
errors.msg: Tag account does not match the message's tag

errors.name: LastManager
errors.msg: Cannot remove the last manager of a namespace

types.name: Admin
docs: A bucket admin. Its existence is the grant.

types.name: Bucket
docs: A bucket of messages. `None` for the key means the bucket is locked and
nothing can be written.

fields.name: next_message_id
docs: Message ids are never reused, so this only grows.

types.name: BucketMetadata
docs: Bucket metadata as supplied at creation.

types.name: BucketWritableWithKey
docs: Emitted on resume and on rotate alike.

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton: the force authority and the id counters.

fields.name: authority
docs: May force-remove anything and seat managers without being one.

fields.name: pending_authority
docs: Proposed replacement; takes over through `accept_authority`.

types.name: Contributor
docs: A bucket contributor. Its existence is the grant.

types.name: Manager
docs: A namespace manager. Its existence is the grant.

types.name: ManagerAdded
docs: `caller` is `None` when the authority seated the manager by force.

types.name: Message
docs: A reference to an encrypted document, with its descriptive metadata.
The contributor paid its rent.

types.name: MessageInput
docs: A message as supplied by a contributor: a reference into the encrypted
storage layer plus descriptive metadata.

types.name: Namespace
docs: An entity's namespace. Managers create buckets under it.

types.name: NamespaceMetadata
docs: Namespace metadata as supplied at creation.

types.name: Property
docs: One free-form key/value pair of metadata.

types.name: Tag
docs: A tag messages in one bucket may carry.

types.name: Viewer
docs: A reader's X25519 public key, listed so contributors know whom to encrypt
for. Viewers never sign anything on chain.

constants.name: ADMIN_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a bucket admin: `["admin", bucket_id, wallet]`.

constants.name: BUCKET_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a bucket: `["bucket", id]`.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the singleton config (authority and id counters).

constants.name: CONTRIBUTOR_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a bucket contributor: `["contributor", bucket_id, wallet]`.

constants.name: MANAGER_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a namespace manager: `["manager", namespace_id, wallet]`.

constants.name: MESSAGE_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a message: `["message", bucket_id, message_id]`.

constants.name: NAMESPACE_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a namespace: `["namespace", id]`.

constants.name: TAG_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a tag: `["tag", bucket_id, sha256(tag)]`.

constants.name: VIEWER_SEED
docs: PDA seed for a bucket viewer: `["viewer", bucket_id, x25519 key]`.
